notes.title: Eiyu*Senki GOLD is Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31027837/a4217236f5ee40967a5abfe4cc42356d1ec7efb1.jpg[/img]

The newest title in the [i]Eiyu*Senki[/i] series, [b]Eiyu*Senki GOLD[/b] is now available on Steam! During its launch week, you can grab it with a special 15% off sale to celebrate its launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1518430/EiyuSenki_Gold__A_New_Conquest/

Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/jast]follow us on Steam[/url]! You can also [url=https://twitter.com/jastusa]check out our Twitter[/url] to get our latest news and ramblings. Want to chat with other visual novel fans?
